tasha: Hey team — noticed a perf regression on Mixtral-7B after the kernel selection tweak yesterday. P95 token latency doubled for some prompts. Anyone seen SDPA/Flash fallbacks spike?
liam: yup, I profiled. FlashAttention fails to initialize for head_dim=48 and we fall back to Triton SDPA which is much slower on our setup.
alex: Do we have failure logs? Is it a head-dim alignment panic or a masking mismatch?
liam: logs: `KernelSelector: flash_init failed: head_dim % 16 != 0` then `sdpa_launch: mask_shape_mismatch` repeatedly. Attaching trimmed profile snippet: ```
# PROFILE (short)
model: mixtral-7b
seq: 512
head_dim: 48
requests: 200
flash_success_rate: 0/200
sdpa_latency_ms: 4.8
flash_latency_ms (expected): 1.9
kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.0 (no prefix cache reuse)
```
tasha: hmm. head_dim=48 is multiple of 16? 48 % 16 == 0 actually. So why flagging %16!=0?
liam: it looks like our kernel selector was using `if (head_dim % preferred_align != 0) -> prefer_triton` where `preferred_align` was set to 32 for some Mistral variants after recent change. That made 48 appear misaligned.
infra-bot: deploy:kernel-selector@canary rolled back to v2.3.1 at 2026-03-03T10:42Z :warning:
mia: Also saw an interaction with RoPE scaling code: when we apply dynamic rope scaling we sometimes compute `kv_stride` that changes effective head bytes and triggers the alignment guard in the runtime. Could be two separate checks tripping.
alex: Good catch. Two fixes to consider: 1) change selector to use gcd-based compat check (allow 16 and 8 compat) instead of single preferred_align; 2) add a lightweight SDPA mask shape shim that accepts common packing layouts.
liam: I benchmarked both ideas locally: shim reduces sdpa_latency to 3.1ms (still > flash 1.9ms) and gcd-based alignment restored flash success to 198/200. End-to-end P95 token latency dropped from 12ms -> 5.2ms.
tasha: Nice. Can you paste the selector patch snippet you tried?
liam: snippet: ```
// previous
if (head_dim % preferred_align != 0) select_triton();
// proposed
if (!is_compatible_with_any(head_dim, {8,16,32})) select_triton();
```
mia: Also proposing a quick KV-cache defensive change: when mask/rope scaling is enabled, avoid aggressive prefix chunking that misaligns offsets. Patch idea: set `preserve_alignment=true` in batching heuristic for scaled-rope models.
alex: Sounds good. Can we add a regression test in perf-suite that runs mixtral/mistral with head_dim variants [32,48,64] and rope scaling on/off to assert flash_success_rate >= 95%?
liam: I'll add tests and a canary config. Plan: roll selector patch + batching preserve_alignment flag to canary cluster tomorrow, monitor infra-metrics (flash_success, sdpa_fallbacks, p95_token_latency).
tasha: Action items: @liam add tests + PR, @alex review selector change, @mia add batching flag + notes in runtime docs. Rollout target: 24h canary, rollback if sdpa_fallbacks > 5% or p95 > baseline +20%.
mia: one more note — quantized Mixtral kernels (int8) currently force a different alignment path; keep that in checklist.
infra-bot: ticket created: RN-2457 "mixtral head-dim alignment -> flash fallback regression" assigned to liam.
liam: will do. updating thread with PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
